description: Source code for AudioRendererPcm class implementing PCM audio rendering with resampling, time stretching, and sink management in a media playback system.

classes.name: IdentityAudioResampler
classes.description: A simple resampler that passes through audio data when input and output formats are the same.

methods.name: GetSinkAudioSampleType
methods.description: Determines the preferred sink audio sample type supported, preferring float32.

methods.name: AudioRendererPcm::AudioRendererPcm
methods.description: Constructor initializing the PCM audio renderer with decoder, sink, stream info, and cache parameters.

methods.name: AudioRendererPcm::~AudioRendererPcm
methods.description: Destructor with cleanup logs.

methods.name: AudioRendererPcm::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the decoder with output callback and error callback.

methods.name: AudioRendererPcm::WriteSamples
methods.description: Feeds input buffers to the decoder for decoding.

methods.name: AudioRendererPcm::WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Signals end of stream to decoder.

methods.name: AudioRendererPcm::SetVolume
methods.description: Sets the volume on the sink.

methods.name: AudioRendererPcm::IsEndOfStreamWritten
methods.description: Checks if end of stream has been written.

methods.name: AudioRendererPcm::IsEndOfStreamPlayed
methods.description: Checks if end of stream has been played.

methods.name: AudioRendererPcm::CanAcceptMoreData
methods.description: Indicates if more data can be accepted for decoding.

methods.name: AudioRendererPcm::Play
methods.description: Resumes playback.

methods.name: AudioRendererPcm::Pause
methods.description: Pauses playback.

methods.name: AudioRendererPcm::SetPlaybackRate
methods.description: Sets the playback rate, affecting speed and direction.

methods.name: AudioRendererPcm::Seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specified media time.

methods.name: AudioRendererPcm::GetCurrentMediaTime
methods.description: Returns current media playback time and status flags.

methods.name: AudioRendererPcm::GetSourceStatus
methods.description: Provides current buffer and sink status.

methods.name: AudioRendererPcm::UpdateVariablesOnSinkThread_Locked
methods.description: Updates internal state based on sink thread variables.

methods.name: AudioRendererPcm::OnFirstOutput
methods.description: Handles initial decoder output, sets up resampling and sink.

methods.name: AudioRendererPcm::IsEndOfStreamPlayed_Locked
methods.description: Checks if EOS has been played.

methods.name: AudioRendererPcm::OnDecoderConsumed
methods.description: Handles decoder consumption callback, updates state.

methods.name: AudioRendererPcm::OnDecoderOutput
methods.description: Handles decoder output, processes audio buffers.

methods.name: AudioRendererPcm::ProcessAudioData
methods.description: Main loop to process decoder output and fill sink buffer.

methods.name: AudioRendererPcm::AppendAudioToFrameBuffer
methods.description: Appends resampled audio data to frame buffer for sink.

methods.name: AudioRendererPcm::CheckAudioSinkStatus
methods.description: Periodically checks sink callback frequency and status.
